- 移除了 skill-card.md 文件，无功能性代码变更
- SKILL.md 描述大幅升级：强调 `eval`、`run-code` 两项代码执行能力、token 认证、`PW_BROWSER_SAFE_MODE` 安全选项和页面/节点隔离边界
- 明确说明 eval/run-code 的攻击面、认证机制和环境变量隔离，提升安全警示与用法风险提示

llm.summary: This is a powerful but clearly disclosed local browser automation skill; its sensitive capabilities are purpose-aligned and guarded enough for installation with caution.

dimensions.detail: The localhost daemon, token authentication, non-headless browser, and optional PW_BROWSER_SAFE_MODE are proportionate to local browser automation, but eval/run-code remain high-impact if used on sensitive logged-in sites.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Install metadata is simple: package.json declares only Playwright as a dependency and no npm lifecycle scripts; the shim only invokes pw-browser.js with NODE_PATH.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions repeatedly limit use to trusted, visible local sessions and tell the agent to avoid unknown code, high-privilege pages, blind login attempts, CAPTCHA bypass, and unconfirmed destructive edits; however, these are documented controls rather than hard per-command confirmation gates.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The daemon is intentionally long-running and writes ~/.pw-browser/daemon.json with a random token; browser state persists while the daemon runs, and screenshots/downloads can write local files when explicitly requested.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill’s purpose is browser automation, and the artifacts openly disclose page JavaScript execution, sandboxed Playwright code execution, credentialed page requests, storage/cookie access, downloads, screenshots, and real webpage actions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you need advanced local browser automation and trust the agent using it. Prefer PW_BROWSER_SAFE_MODE=1 unless custom JavaScript or Playwright code is necessary, avoid using eval/run-code on sensitive logged-in accounts, and close the daemon with close --all when finished.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The capability is real, but SKILL.md front matter and body explicitly disclose eval, run-code, cookie/storage access, credentialed requests, localhost daemon behavior, token auth, and safe mode, so this is not hidden or purpose-mismatched.
[SDI-4] expected: The docs do say the vm sandbox lacks direct fs/process/require access while also warning that browser-mediated downloads can write to disk and should avoid overwriting files; this is a disclosure nuance rather than deceptive behavior.
[SQP-1] expected: The skill depends on operator judgment for trusted local use, but it clearly documents unsuitable scenarios such as untrusted agents, public API service exposure, and CI use without extra controls.
[SQP-2] expected: Eval and run-code are powerful confused-deputy primitives against authenticated browser sessions, but they are central to the advertised advanced automation purpose, local-token gated, safe-mode disableable, and prominently warned about.
